rows.abstract: The bill seeks to establish livelihood and employment resource centers in every municipality and city to complement the national livelihood programs.  The centers shall focus on the production of goods that are not ordinarily included in industrial manufacturing.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on TRADE AND INDUSTRY since 2006-09-20

rows.title_short: Budget 2007
rows.status: REPUBLIC ACT (RA09401) enacted on 2007-03-22

second_reading.remarks: On Oct. 04, 2006, the Body approved to insert the sponsorship speech of Rep. Gullas into the Record of the House. On Oct. 13, 2006, on motion of Rep. Lagman and concurred by Rep. Escudero, perfecting amendments submitted by the Members were received, collated and approved. On the same date, Rep. Escudero manifested the intention of the Minority to submit their turno en contra on the measure.

third_reading.remarks: On Dec. 04, 2006, the Senate passed with amendments HB05794. The President approved and signed into law HB05794 with veto on certain special and general provisions.

rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTIONALIZING AND FURTHER DEVELOPING \"117\" AS THE NATIONWIDE EMERGENCY ASSISTANCE TELEPHONE NUMBER FOR PUBLIC SAFETY AND SECURITY AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Hotline '117' Act of 2006.\"
rows.abstract: “Hotline ‘117’ Act of 2006”.  The bill designates telephone number ‘117’ as the nationwide emergency assistance number for both landline and wireless telephone systems.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2006-12-20, transmitted to on 2007-01-24 and received by the Senate on 2007-01-24

second_reading.remarks: On Dec. 04, 2006, the Body approved to consider the Explanatory Note of the Bill as the sponsorship remarks on the measure.

rows.author: E046
rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL LOCAL GOVERNMENT UNITS TO TRANSLATE OFFICIAL DOCUMENTS, PROCEDURES, RULES, REGULATIONS, ANNOUNCEMENTS, ADVERTISEMENTS INTO THEIR RESPECTIVE DIALECTS FOR THE GUIDANCE OF THE PUBLIC
rows.abstract: For the benefit of those who are not well-versed in the English and Filipino languages, the bill mandates that all official documents, procedures, announcements, rules and regulations necessary to transact with local government units to be translated to the local dialect.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on LOCAL GOVERNMENT since 2006-09-25

rows.title_full: AN ACT REGULATING THE PRACTICE OF INDUSTRIAL ENGINEERING IN THE PHILIPPINES, PROVIDING PENALTIES FOR VIOLATIONS THEREOF, APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR, AND FOR OTHER PURPOSES
rows.title_short: \"Industrial Engineering Act of 2006\"
rows.abstract: \"Industrial Engineering Act of 2006\".  The bill seeks to define the scope of the practice of industrial engineering and upgrade the course or training to ensure that our industrial enngineers are at par with the best in the world.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on CIVIL SERVICE AND PROFESSIONAL REGULATION since 2006-09-25
